profile.socialsHint: Optional. Your handle or number on each app.

bookings.emptyHint: Pick a workshop you like and reserve your first spot.

when.inDays: In {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

bookings.confirmHint: Open the link in your confirmation email to confirm this booking.

cancelBlocked.started: It is too late to cancel: the workshop has started.

affiliate.intro: Register for a workshop, copy its Affiliate link and send it to people you invite. The link takes them to the booking of that workshop.
affiliate.totalHint: {count, plural, =0 {You are not registered for any workshop yet.} one {From # workshop you registered for.} other {From # workshops you registered for.}}

affiliate.fee: Affiliate fee: {rate} of the booking price
affiliate.earned: Earned {amount} · {count, plural, one {# paid booking} other {# paid bookings}} · {clicks, plural, one {# click} other {# clicks}}
affiliate.linksEmpty: You have no Affiliate links yet. Register for a workshop in Program to get your first one.
affiliate.deactiveHint: This workshop is deactivated: its link no longer leads to a booking.

referrals.intro: Invite friends to register a customer account with your link. You have one link, and it stays the same.
referrals.linkHint: Send it to a friend. When they register through it, they become your referral.
referrals.copyFailed: The link could not be copied.
referrals.totalHint: {rate} of the booking price, on the first paid booking of each friend.
referrals.empty: No friend has registered through your link yet.

status.REGISTERED: Registered, waiting for a paid booking

referrals.note: You earn the bonus only once for each referral: when your friend registers through your link and pays their first booking, you earn {rate} of that booking's price. Their later bookings do not earn more.
